Real weight in everything. The garment is soft cloth crushed down into the case by

Dialogue language: American English. REBECCA's voice: low, dry, tired — here hard

IN SHOT B, DANIEL, mid-shout, already at full volume when the shot opens:

IN SHOT D, REBECCA, mid-sentence, hard and level, not shouting: {—can't do this

<sound effect: each time the picture burns out to white, a short dry rush cutting

THIS IS THE END OF AN ARGUMENT THAT HAS BEEN GOING ON FOR HOURS, and both of them
are past their best tactics.
REBECCA'S OBJECTIVE: to get out of the room. She is not weeping and not shouting —
she has gone quiet and hard, which is worse. HER HANDS DO THE ANGER: one flat palm

PACKS, and when she does look at him, in the last shot, it is level and finished.
The suitcase is heavy and that weight is in her shoulder and her stance all through
the last shot.
DANIEL'S OBJECTIVE: to make her stop and listen. HE IS THE ONE LOSING AND HE IS
THE ONE SHOUTING — the volume is the tell. He repeats himself because he has
nothing better. His face is loud and open, no control left in it, leaning toward
her across the bed he cannot cross.
NEITHER OF THEM NOTICES THE ROOM. It changes around them and nothing in either

arguing straight through it.
Living eyes for both, reactions starting before the other has finished.

1960s film stock pushed and overexposed: heavy grain, blown highlights, halation
